site_fit.about: CAD plan (x east, y north in the drawing, metres) to the map's local ENU metres round the atlas pin: ENU = R(rot) * (p - plate_centroid) + footprint_centroid + [dx, dy]. Twin GLB local (Blender x, y) to ENU: ENU = R(phi) * b + C.
site_fit.why: The footprint is close to a rectangle, so a 180 deg turn scores almost the same. The chosen one puts the CAD's lift core toward the street front (bearing 146), where the twin's entrance is. The drawing's own north arrow does not agree with the footprint by about 100 deg, so it is treated as project north.
site_fit.front_shift_why: Slid back along the long axis so Volt's front wall meets the twin's front (the annex face with the entrance porch). The real footprint and the CAD put the front about 1.6 m further out than the twin does.

podium_about: Two-storey glass block (ground and first floor, 9.7 m like the annex) where the CAD's first floor runs beyond the twin. Plan coordinates.

stairs.about: Square open-well stair read from the CAD STAIR layer (note on the plan: WIDTH 1500, TREAD 300, RISER 3900/25). Step order follows the tread lines: south strip east, east winder north, north strip west, west winder south. Heights are 25 risers of 156 mm.
